Class BillServiceTest

@IsTest
private class BillServiceTest

Test class for BillService. Validates bill calculation functionality including service fees, fixed fees, tips processing, credit card fee integration, and agent commission calculations.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void deleteCheckoutRecordsTest()

Tests the deleteCheckoutRecords() method for deleting bill and all related records. Validates that all checkout records are correctly deleted in the proper order including:
  • BillCommission__c
  • BillAgentCommission__c
  • BillStripeTransaction__c
  • BillCollection__c
  • BillAdjustment__c
  • BillPayment__c
  • OrderPayment__c
  • Payment2__c
  • Bill__c.

Since:
    12/22/2025

@IsTest
private static void promoteCheckoutToLedgerTest()

Tests the promoteCheckoutToLedger() method for copying bill and related records to ledger objects. Validates that all checkout records are correctly copied to their corresponding ledger objects including:
  • Bill__c to VenuePayout__c
  • Payment2__c to OrderPaymentLedger__c
  • BillPayment__c to OrderPaymentPayout__c
  • OrderPayment__c to OrderPaymentLine__c
  • BillAdjustment__c to VenuePayoutAdjustment__c
  • BillCollection__c to VenuePayoutCollection__c
  • BillStripeTransaction__c to VenuePayoutStripeTransaction__c
  • BillAgentCommission__c to VenuePayoutAgentCommission__c
  • BillCommission__c to VenuePayoutCommission__c.

Since:
    12/20/2025

@IsTest
private static void testCalculateAgentsCommissionsAsync()

Tests the calculateAgentsCommissionsAsync() method for agent commission calculations. Validates that BillAgentCommission__c records are created correctly for agents assigned to the account via AccountContactRelation, with proper commission percentage and negative commission amounts. Also verifies that previous commission records not matching current agents are deleted.

@IsTest
private static void testRefreshCalculations1()

Tests the refreshCalculations() method for basic fee calculations. Validates that service fees are calculated correctly based on fixed fees per payment and percentage fees on collected amounts, and that tips for business are calculated correctly after applying tip fees.

@IsTest
private static void testRefreshCalculations2()

Tests the refreshCalculations() method with credit card fees included. Validates that service fees are calculated correctly when credit card processing fees are deducted from the service fee total. Also tests the refreshValidateAmounts parameter to verify subtotal, tips, and tax validation fields are updated.
